func testIdentity() identity {
	return identity{"run_1", strings.Repeat("a", 40), strings.Repeat("b", 64)}
}

func TestControlResponsesBindRunAndRejectAmbiguity(t *testing.T) {
	id := testIdentity()
	valid := response{identity: id, Phase: "boot", Op: "boot-ready", Status: "ok"}
	encode := func(value response) []byte {
		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return append([]byte(responsePrefix), data...)
	}
	if got, err := parseResponse(encode(valid), id); err != nil || got.Op != "boot-ready" {
		t.Fatalf("valid response: %v %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := parseResponse([]byte("server: serving; readiness not proven"), id); err != nil || got != nil {
		t.Fatalf("raw log interpreted as control: %v %v", got, err)
	}
	for name, change := range map[string]func(*response){
		"wrong-run":      func(r *response) { r.RunID = "other" },
		"wrong-source":   func(r *response) { r.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("c", 40) },
		"wrong-nonce":    func(r *response) { r.Nonce = strings.Repeat("c", 64) },
		"unknown-status": func(r *response) { r.Status = "ready" },
		"guest-error":    func(r *response) { r.Status = "error"; r.Category = "mount"; r.Cause = "read-only volume" },
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			value := valid
			change(&value)
			if _, err := parseResponse(encode(value), id); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("accepted invalid response")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, line := range [][]byte{
		[]byte(responsePrefix + `{"status":"ok","unexpected":true}`),
		append(encode(valid), []byte(` {}`)...),
		[]byte(responsePrefix + strings.Repeat(" ", controlLimit)),
	} {
		if _, err := parseResponse(line, id); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("accepted ambiguous or oversized response")
		}
	}
}

type fakeChild struct {
	input          io.WriteCloser
	output, stderr io.ReadCloser
	done           chan struct{}
	result         error
	forced         bool
	finishes       int
	finishErr      error
	finishDeadline time.Time
	finishBefore   func(time.Time) (bool, error)
	verify         func(context.Context, net.Conn) (map[string]any, error)
	verifications  int
	doneCalled     func()
}

func (p *fakeChild) Input() io.WriteCloser { return p.input }
func (p *fakeChild) Output() io.ReadCloser { return p.output }
func (p *fakeChild) Errors() io.ReadCloser { return p.stderr }
func (p *fakeChild) Done() <-chan struct{} {
	if p.doneCalled != nil {
		p.doneCalled()
	}
	return p.done
}
func (p *fakeChild) Result() error         { return p.result }
func (p *fakeChild) PID() uint32           { return 42 }
func (p *fakeChild) Finish() (bool, error) { return p.FinishBefore(time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)) }
func (p *fakeChild) FinishBefore(deadline time.Time) (bool, error) {
	p.finishes++
	p.finishDeadline = deadline
	if p.finishBefore != nil {
		return p.finishBefore(deadline)
	}
	return p.forced, p.finishErr
}
func (p *fakeChild) VerifyControlPeer(ctx context.Context, conn net.Conn) (map[string]any, error) {
	p.verifications++
	if p.verify != nil {
		return p.verify(ctx, conn)
	}
	return map[string]any{"owner_pid": p.PID()}, nil
}

type nopWriteCloser struct{ io.Writer }

func (nopWriteCloser) Close() error { return nil }

type fakePlatform struct {
	process   *fakeChild
	startErr  error
	listener  net.Listener
	listenErr error
	listen    func(context.Context) (net.Listener, error)
	start     func(string, []string, string) (child, error)
}

func (p fakePlatform) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) { return nil, nil }
func (p fakePlatform) ListenControl(ctx context.Context) (net.Listener, error) {
	if p.listen != nil {
		return p.listen(ctx)
	}
	return p.listener, p.listenErr
}
func (p fakePlatform) Start(executable string, args []string, directory string) (child, error) {
	if p.start != nil {
		return p.start(executable, args, directory)
	}
	return p.process, p.startErr
}
func childWithOutput(output string, completed bool) *fakeChild {
	child := &fakeChild{input: nopWriteCloser{io.Discard}, output: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(output)), stderr: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("")), done: make(chan struct{})}
	if completed {
		close(child.done)
	}
	return child
}

func TestGuestAcknowledgementsRequireSequenceAndConfirmedExit(t *testing.T) {
	zero := 0
	id := testIdentity()
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name     string
		message  response
		op       string
		sequence uint64
		valid    bool
	}{
		{"stop-confirmed", response{identity: id, Phase: "stop-authority", Sequence: 2, Op: "stop-authority", Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero}, "stop-authority", 2, true},
		{"stop-no-exit", response{identity: id, Phase: "stop-authority", Sequence: 2, Op: "stop-authority", Status: "ok"}, "stop-authority", 2, false},
		{"stale-start", response{identity: id, Phase: "start", Sequence: 1, Op: "start", Status: "ok"}, "start", 3, false},
		{"wrong-phase", response{identity: id, Phase: "boot", Sequence: 1, Op: "start", Status: "ok"}, "start", 1, false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			channel := &guestChannel{child: childWithOutput("", false), identity: id, responses: make(chan response, 1), fault: make(chan error, 1)}
			channel.responses <- test.message
			_, err := channel.receive(context.Background(), test.sequence, test.op, test.op)
			if (err == nil) != test.valid {
				t.Fatalf("valid=%v err=%v", test.valid, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGuestControlTimeoutDoesNotClaimExit(t *testing.T) {
	channel := &guestChannel{child: childWithOutput("", false), identity: testIdentity(), responses: make(chan response, 1), fault: make(chan error, 1)}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
	defer cancel()
	if _, err := channel.command(ctx, 1, "shutdown"); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("unconfirmed command: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := commandBytes(channel.Nonce, 0, "start"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("zero sequence accepted")
	}
	if _, err := commandBytes(channel.Nonce, 1, "restart"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown command accepted")
	}
}

func TestToolOwnershipOnSuccessFailureAndCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"success", "nonzero", "cancel", "forced"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			process := childWithOutput("tool output", name != "cancel")
			process.forced = name == "forced"
			if name == "nonzero" {
				process.result = errors.New("exit code 7")
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
			defer cancel()
			output, err := runTool(ctx, fakePlatform{process: process}, "tool", nil, privateTestDirectory(t), "tool")
			if name == "success" && (err != nil || string(output) != "tool output") {
				t.Fatalf("success %q %v", output, err)
			}
			if name != "success" && err == nil {
				t.Fatal("failure reported success")
			}
			if process.finishes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("owned process finish count %d", process.finishes)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestStreamOverflowIsFailureWithMarker(t *testing.T) {
	var output bytes.Buffer
	writer := &cappedWriter{writer: &output, remaining: 5}
	if _, err := writer.Write([]byte("0123456789")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("overflow was hidden")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(output.String(), "truncated") || !strings.HasPrefix(output.String(), "01234") {
		t.Fatalf("missing bounded evidence %q", output.String())
	}
}

func TestProbeReceiptCannotUseWrongSourceOrEmptyIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	id := testIdentity()
	value := response{identity: id, Phase: "readiness-create", Sequence: 1, Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: "epoch", ObjectID: "object"}
	encode := func() []byte {
		data, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return data
	}
	if _, err := validateProbe(encode(), id, value.Phase, 1); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	value.AuthorityEpoch = ""
	if _, err := validateProbe(encode(), id, value.Phase, 1); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty authority accepted")
	}
	value.AuthorityEpoch = "epoch"
	value.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("c", 40)
	if _, err := validateProbe(encode(), id, value.Phase, 1); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign source accepted")
	}
}

func TestArtifactTraversalAndHashMismatchFail(t *testing.T) {
	root := privateTestDirectory(t)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "input"), []byte("source"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash, _, err := fileHash(filepath.Join(root, "input"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := verifyFiles(root, map[string]string{"input": hash}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{"../input", "/input", `a\input`, "a/../input", "./input", "C:/input"} {
		if _, err := safePath(root, path); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("traversal accepted: %s", path)
		}
	}
	if err := verifyFiles(root, map[string]string{"input": strings.Repeat("0", 64)}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("hash mismatch accepted")
	}
}

func TestPrivateDiskCopyBindsExpectedHash(t *testing.T) {
	directory := privateTestDirectory(t)
	source := filepath.Join(directory, "source")
	if err := os.WriteFile(source, []byte("pristine"), 0400); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash, size, err := fileHash(source)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	expected := artifact{SHA256: hash, Size: size}
	if err := copyDisk(source, filepath.Join(directory, "copy"), expected); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	expected.SHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	if err := copyDisk(source, filepath.Join(directory, "mismatch"), expected); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed pristine disk accepted")
	}
	actual, _, err := fileHash(source)
	if err != nil || actual != hash {
		t.Fatalf("source changed: %s %v", actual, err)
	}
}

func TestQEMULaunchLimitsNetworkAndUsesPrivateDisk(t *testing.T) {
	var m manifest
	m.BootToken = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	m.Volume = "fixture-current"
	m.QEMU.Machine = "pc-q35-11.1"
	args := qemuArguments(m, testIdentity(), "kernel", "initramfs", "private,data", "bios", 43210, 43111)
	joined := strings.Join(args, " ")
	for _, required := range []string{"-L bios", "-accel tcg,thread=multi", "restrict=on", "hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:43210-10.0.2.15:8080", "file=private,,data,format=raw", "rng-builtin", "RFS_FIXTURE_NONCE=", "-chardev socket,id=console,host=127.0.0.1,port=43111,server=off,reconnect-ms=0", "-serial chardev:console"} {
		if !strings.Contains(joined, required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", required)
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(joined, "hostfwd=") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("multiple forwards")
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"cache=unsafe", "-virtfs", "-fsdev", "-qmp", "rng-random", "whpx", "stdio", "server=on"} {
		if strings.Contains(joined, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("forbidden %s", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestFramedAuthorityOutputCannotForgeGuestControl(t *testing.T) {
	var output bytes.Buffer
	logs := map[string]*cappedWriter{"stdout": {writer: &output, remaining: streamLimit}, "stderr": {writer: io.Discard, remaining: streamLimit}}
	forged := responsePrefix + `{"status":"ok"}`
	line := "RFS-AUTHORITY/stdout " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(forged))
	handled, err := authorityLogLine([]byte(line), logs)
	if err != nil || !handled || output.String() != forged {
		t.Fatalf("frame was not isolated: %v %v %q", handled, err, output.String())
	}
	for _, line := range []string{"RFS-AUTHORITY/stdout invalid!", "RFS-AUTHORITY/unknown YQ=="} {
		if handled, err := authorityLogLine([]byte(line), logs); !handled || err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("malformed frame accepted: %q", line)
		}
	}
}

func TestDuplicateJSONFieldsCannotOverrideIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	id := testIdentity()
	data, err := json.Marshal(response{identity: id, Phase: "boot", Op: "boot-ready", Status: "ok"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data = append(data[:len(data)-1], []byte(`,"run_id":"run_1"}`)...)
	if _, err := parseResponse(append([]byte(responsePrefix), data...), id); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate identity field accepted")
	}
	var target map[string]any
	if err := decodeOne([]byte(`{"source_files":{"x":"a","x":"b"}}`), &target); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate nested source hash accepted")
	}
}

func privateTestDirectory(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "private")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return path
}

func hostPEFixture(t *testing.T, path string, machine uint16) {
	t.Helper()
	var image bytes.Buffer
	dos := make([]byte, 128)
	copy(dos, []byte("MZ"))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(dos[0x3c:], 128)
	image.Write(dos)
	image.Write([]byte{'P', 'E', 0, 0})
	header := pe.FileHeader{Machine: machine, SizeOfOptionalHeader: 240, Characteristics: pe.IMAGE_FILE_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE | pe.IMAGE_FILE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE}
	optional := pe.OptionalHeader64{Magic: 0x20b, ImageBase: 0x140000000, SectionAlignment: 4096, FileAlignment: 512, SizeOfImage: 4096, SizeOfHeaders: 512, Subsystem: pe.IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_CUI, NumberOfRvaAndSizes: 16}
	if err := binary.Write(&image, binary.LittleEndian, header); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := binary.Write(&image, binary.LittleEndian, optional); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, image.Bytes(), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestNativeHostPEPolicyPrecedesPlatform(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name      string
		machines  [3]uint16
		malformed int
		valid     bool
	}{
		{name: "native-arm64", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: -1, valid: true},
		{name: "all-x64", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64}, malformed: -1},
		{name: "x64-qemu", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: -1},
		{name: "x64-probe", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: -1},
		{name: "x64-controller", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64}, malformed: -1},
		{name: "malformed-qemu", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: 0},
		{name: "malformed-probe", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: 1},
		{name: "malformed-controller", machines: [3]uint16{pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64, pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64}, malformed: 2},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			directory := privateTestDirectory(t)
			paths := [3]string{filepath.Join(directory, "qemu-system-x86_64.exe"), filepath.Join(directory, "probe.exe"), filepath.Join(directory, "controller.exe")}
			for index, path := range paths {
				hostPEFixture(t, path, test.machines[index])
			}
			if test.malformed >= 0 {
				if err := os.WriteFile(paths[test.malformed], []byte("MZ truncated"), 0600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			original := newPlatform
			calls := 0
			newPlatform = func() (platform, error) { calls++; return fakePlatform{}, nil }
			defer func() { newPlatform = original }()
			host, err := nativeHostPlatform(paths[0], paths[1], paths[2])
			if test.valid {
				if err != nil || host == nil || calls != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("native host rejected: calls=%d error=%v", calls, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil || host != nil || calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("invalid host reached platform: calls=%d error=%v", calls, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

type observedControlConn struct {
	net.Conn
	local, remote         net.Addr
	write                 func([]byte) (int, error)
	setWriteDeadline      func(time.Time) error
	closeError            error
	reads, writes, closes atomic.Int32
}

func (c *observedControlConn) LocalAddr() net.Addr  { return c.local }
func (c *observedControlConn) RemoteAddr() net.Addr { return c.remote }
func (c *observedControlConn) Read(data []byte) (int, error) {
	c.reads.Add(1)
	return c.Conn.Read(data)
}
func (c *observedControlConn) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	c.writes.Add(1)
	if c.write != nil {
		return c.write(data)
	}
	return c.Conn.Write(data)
}
func (c *observedControlConn) SetWriteDeadline(deadline time.Time) error {
	if c.setWriteDeadline != nil {
		return c.setWriteDeadline(deadline)
	}
	return c.Conn.SetWriteDeadline(deadline)
}
func (c *observedControlConn) Close() error {
	c.closes.Add(1)
	return errors.Join(c.Conn.Close(), c.closeError)
}

func controlTestPair(t *testing.T) (*observedControlConn, net.Conn) {
	t.Helper()
	controller, peer := net.Pipe()
	t.Cleanup(func() { controller.Close(); peer.Close() })
	return &observedControlConn{Conn: controller,
		local:  &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 40001},
		remote: &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 40002}}, peer
}

type controlAcceptResult struct {
	conn net.Conn
	err  error
}
type testControlListener struct {
	result          chan controlAcceptResult
	entered, closed chan struct{}
	closeOnce       sync.Once
	closeError      error
	accept          func() (net.Conn, error)
	address         net.Addr
	closes          atomic.Int32
}

func newTestControlListener(t *testing.T) *testControlListener {
	t.Helper()
	l := &testControlListener{result: make(chan controlAcceptResult, 1), entered: make(chan struct{}), closed: make(chan struct{})}
	t.Cleanup(func() { l.Close() })
	return l
}
func (l *testControlListener) Addr() net.Addr {
	if l.address != nil {
		return l.address
	}
	return &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 40001}
}
func (l *testControlListener) Accept() (net.Conn, error) {
	close(l.entered)
	if l.accept != nil {
		return l.accept()
	}
	select {
	case result := <-l.result:
		return result.conn, result.err
	case <-l.closed:
		return nil, net.ErrClosed
	}
}
func (l *testControlListener) Close() error {
	l.closes.Add(1)
	l.closeOnce.Do(func() { close(l.closed) })
	return l.closeError
}

func socketTestContext(t *testing.T) context.Context {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	return ctx
}

func controlResponseLine(t *testing.T, message response) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(message)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return append(append([]byte(responsePrefix), data...), '\n')
}

func TestControlSocketAuthenticationBeforeIO(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("foreign process")
	for _, name := range []string{"owned", "wrong-owner", "missing-evidence", "bad-local-port", "bad-remote", "typed-nil-remote", "expired-during-proof", "listener-close-error"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
			listener := newTestControlListener(t)
			if name == "bad-local-port" {
				conn.local = &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 40003}
			}
			if name == "bad-remote" {
				conn.remote = &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.ParseIP("::1"), Port: 40002}
			}
			if name == "typed-nil-remote" {
				conn.remote = (*net.TCPAddr)(nil)
			}
			if name == "listener-close-error" {
				listener.closeError = failure
			}
			listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{conn: conn}
			control := newControlSocket(listener)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(socketTestContext(t))
			defer cancel()
			process := childWithOutput("", false)
			process.verify = func(context.Context, net.Conn) (map[string]any, error) {
				if name == "wrong-owner" {
					return nil, failure
				}
				if name == "missing-evidence" {
					return nil, nil
				}
				if name == "expired-during-proof" {
					cancel()
				}
				return map[string]any{"owner_pid": process.PID()}, nil
			}
			accepted, facts, err := control.accept(ctx, process, make(chan error))
			if name == "owned" {
				if err != nil || accepted != conn || facts["owner_pid"] != process.PID() {
					t.Fatalf("owned proof: %v %v", facts, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil || accepted != nil || facts != nil {
				t.Fatalf("rejected peer was admitted: %v %v", facts, err)
			}
			if conn.reads.Load() != 0 || conn.writes.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("control bytes consumed before peer authentication")
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "bad-") || name == "typed-nil-remote" || name == "listener-close-error" {
				if process.verifications != 0 {
					t.Fatal("invalid endpoint reached process verification")
				}
			} else if process.verifications != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("proof count %d", process.verifications)
			}
			closeErr := control.closeIO()
			if name == "listener-close-error" && !errors.Is(closeErr, failure) {
				t.Fatalf("lost close error: %v", closeErr)
			}
			if name != "listener-close-error" && closeErr != nil {
				t.Fatal(closeErr)
			}
			_ = control.closeIO()
			if conn.closes.Load() != 1 || listener.closes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatal("control resources were not closed exactly once")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestControlSocketInterruptedAcceptJoinsOwner(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("control accept failure")
	for _, name := range []string{"cancellation", "child-exit", "diagnostic-fault", "accept-error", "empty-accept"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			listener := newTestControlListener(t)
			control := newControlSocket(listener)
			process := childWithOutput("", false)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(socketTestContext(t))
			defer cancel()
			fault := make(chan error, 1)
			select {
			case <-listener.entered:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("accept did not start")
			}
			switch name {
			case "cancellation":
				cancel()
			case "child-exit":
				close(process.done)
			case "diagnostic-fault":
				fault <- failure
			case "accept-error":
				listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{err: failure}
			case "empty-accept":
				listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{}
			}
			if conn, facts, err := control.accept(ctx, process, fault); err == nil || conn != nil || facts != nil {
				t.Fatalf("interrupted accept succeeded: %v", err)
			}
			if process.verifications != 0 {
				t.Fatal("failed accept reached peer verification")
			}
			if err := control.closeIO(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_ = control.join(socketTestContext(t))
			select {
			case <-control.done:
			default:
				t.Fatal("accept owner still running after close")
			}
			if listener.closes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatal("listener closed more than once")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestControlSocketClosesLateAcceptedConnection(t *testing.T) {
	conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
	listener := newTestControlListener(t)
	release := make(chan struct{})
	var releaseOnce sync.Once
	unblock := func() { releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(release) }) }
	defer unblock()
	listener.accept = func() (net.Conn, error) { <-release; return conn, nil }
	control := newControlSocket(listener)
	ctx := socketTestContext(t)
	select {
	case <-listener.entered:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal("accept did not start")
	}
	_, err := finishGuest(nil, control, nil, time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("unfinished accept lost deadline: %v", err)
	}
	unblock()
	if err := control.join(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if conn.closes.Load() != 1 || listener.closes.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("late connection escaped its closed owner")
	}
	if err := control.closeIO(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if conn.closes.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("late connection closed twice")
	}
}

func TestGuestSocketCommandFramingAndNaturalEOF(t *testing.T) {
	for _, op := range []string{"start", "stop-authority", "shutdown"} {
		t.Run(op, func(t *testing.T) {
			conn, peer := controlTestPair(t)
			directory := privateTestDirectory(t)
			guest, err := newGuestChannel(testIdentity(), directory)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer guest.closeLogs()
			guest.startDiagnostics(childWithOutput("QEMU diagnostics\n", false))
			guest.startSerial(conn)
			zero := 0
			ack := controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: op, Sequence: 7, Op: op, Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero})
			exchange := make(chan error, 1)
			allowEOF := make(chan struct{})
			go func() {
				line, err := bufio.NewReader(peer).ReadBytes('\n')
				if err == nil {
					want, encodeErr := commandBytes(testIdentity().Nonce, 7, op)
					if encodeErr != nil {
						err = encodeErr
					} else if !bytes.Equal(line, want) {
						err = errors.New("command differs from exact JSONL frame")
					}
				}
				if err == nil {
					_, err = peer.Write(ack[:9])
				}
				if err == nil {
					_, err = peer.Write(ack[9:])
				}
				if err == nil {
					<-allowEOF
				}
				exchange <- errors.Join(err, peer.Close())
			}()
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			value, commandErr := guest.command(ctx, 7, op)
			close(allowEOF)
			if commandErr != nil || value.Op != op || value.Sequence != 7 {
				t.Fatalf("socket command: %v %v", value, commandErr)
			}
			select {
			case err := <-exchange:
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("peer exchange did not finish")
			}
			if err := joinReaders(ctx, guest.readers); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if conn.writes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("command wrote %d frames", conn.writes.Load())
			}
			if err := guest.closeLogs(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			serial, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, "guest-serial.log"))
			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(serial, ack) {
				t.Fatalf("serial evidence: %q %v", serial, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGuestCommandCancellationReleasesBackpressuredWrite(t *testing.T) {
	conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
	entered := make(chan struct{})
	conn.write = func(data []byte) (int, error) { close(entered); return conn.Conn.Write(data) }
	guest := &guestChannel{child: childWithOutput("", false), identity: testIdentity(), conn: conn, responses: make(chan response, 1), fault: make(chan error, 1)}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(socketTestContext(t))
	defer cancel()
	finished := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := guest.command(ctx, 1, "start"); finished <- err }()
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal("command did not reach write")
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case err := <-finished:
		if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Fatalf("write cancellation lost cause: %v", err)
		}
	case <-socketTestContext(t).Done():
		t.Fatal("canceled socket writer survived")
	}
	if conn.writes.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("canceled command was retried")
	}
}

func TestGuestSocketCommandFailures(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("socket operation failed")
	for _, name := range []string{"short-write", "write-error", "deadline-error", "reset-error", "stale-ack", "wrong-phase", "stop-no-exit", "unsolicited", "reader-fault", "unbounded", "unauthenticated"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
			guest := &guestChannel{child: childWithOutput("", false), identity: testIdentity(), conn: conn, responses: make(chan response, 1), fault: make(chan error, 1)}
			op := "start"
			if name == "stop-no-exit" {
				op = "stop-authority"
			}
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			if name == "unbounded" {
				ctx = context.Background()
			}
			if name == "unauthenticated" {
				guest.conn = nil
			}
			if name == "unsolicited" {
				guest.responses <- response{Op: "start"}
			}
			if name == "reader-fault" {
				guest.fault <- failure
			}
			conn.write = func(data []byte) (int, error) {
				if name == "short-write" {
					return len(data) - 1, nil
				}
				if name == "write-error" {
					return 0, failure
				}
				ack := response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: op, Sequence: 2, Op: op, Status: "ok"}
				if name == "stale-ack" {
					ack.Sequence = 1
				}
				if name == "wrong-phase" {
					ack.Phase = "boot"
				}
				guest.responses <- ack
				return len(data), nil
			}
			conn.setWriteDeadline = func(deadline time.Time) error {
				if name == "deadline-error" || name == "reset-error" && deadline.IsZero() {
					return failure
				}
				return nil
			}
			_, err := guest.command(ctx, 2, op)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid command exchange succeeded")
			}
			if name == "short-write" && !errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) {
				t.Fatalf("short write lost cause: %v", err)
			}
			if (name == "write-error" || name == "deadline-error" || name == "reset-error" || name == "reader-fault") && !errors.Is(err, failure) {
				t.Fatalf("lost error cause: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "unbounded" || name == "unauthenticated" || name == "unsolicited" || name == "reader-fault" || name == "deadline-error" {
				if conn.writes.Load() != 0 {
					t.Fatal("invalid command reached socket write")
				}
			} else if conn.writes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatal("command was retried")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGuestSerialFramingAndProcessLogIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	id := testIdentity()
	boot := controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: id, Phase: "boot", Op: "boot-ready", Status: "ok"})
	for _, name := range []string{"complete", "empty-eof", "no-final-lf", "wrong-identity", "duplicate", "authority-frame"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			conn, peer := controlTestPair(t)
			directory := privateTestDirectory(t)
			guest, err := newGuestChannel(id, directory)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer guest.closeLogs()
			guest.startDiagnostics(childWithOutput(string(boot), false))
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			if err := joinReaders(ctx, guest.readers); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			select {
			case <-guest.responses:
				t.Fatal("process stdout forged a control response")
			default:
			}
			guest.startSerial(conn)
			data := bytes.Clone(boot)
			switch name {
			case "empty-eof":
				data = nil
			case "no-final-lf":
				data = data[:len(data)-1]
			case "wrong-identity":
				other := id
				other.Nonce = strings.Repeat("c", 64)
				data = controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: other, Phase: "boot", Op: "boot-ready", Status: "ok"})
			case "duplicate":
				data = append(data, boot...)
			case "authority-frame":
				data = append([]byte("RFS-AUTHORITY/stdout "+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(boot)+"\n"), data...)
			}
			written := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				var err error
				if len(data) > 0 {
					_, err = peer.Write(data)
				}
				written <- errors.Join(err, peer.Close())
			}()
			select {
			case err := <-written:
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("serial write did not finish")
			}
			joinErr := joinReaders(ctx, guest.readers)
			valid := name == "complete" || name == "authority-frame"
			validStream := valid || name == "empty-eof"
			if validStream && joinErr != nil || !validStream && joinErr == nil {
				t.Fatalf("framing result=%v valid=%v", joinErr, validStream)
			}
			if name == "no-final-lf" && !errors.Is(joinErr, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
				t.Fatalf("truncated serial accepted: %v", joinErr)
			}
			_, err = guest.receive(ctx, 0, "boot-ready", "boot")
			if valid && err != nil || !valid && err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid serial produced acknowledgement: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "empty-eof" && !errors.Is(err, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
				t.Fatalf("empty serial lost EOF: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "authority-frame" {
				got, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, "authority-stdout.log"))
				if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, boot) {
					t.Fatalf("authority bytes lost: %q %v", got, err)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGuestCleanupPreservesDeadlineAndFailures(t *testing.T) {
	finishError := errors.New("job query failed")
	readError := errors.New("diagnostic read failed")
	for _, name := range []string{"complete", "forced", "job-error", "reader-error", "unfinished-reader", "log-close-error"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			guest, err := newGuestChannel(testIdentity(), privateTestDirectory(t))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer guest.closeLogs()
			reader := &ownedReader{name: "controlled reader", done: make(chan struct{})}
			if name == "reader-error" {
				reader.err = readError
			}
			if name != "unfinished-reader" {
				close(reader.done)
			}
			guest.readers = []*ownedReader{reader}
			if name == "log-close-error" {
				if err := guest.logs["guest-serial"].Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			process := childWithOutput("", true)
			process.forced = name == "forced"
			if name == "job-error" {
				process.finishErr = finishError
			}
			deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
			if name == "unfinished-reader" {
				deadline = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
			}
			forced, err := finishGuest(process, nil, guest, deadline)
			if process.finishes != 1 || !process.finishDeadline.Equal(deadline) {
				t.Fatal("cleanup restarted or replaced its absolute deadline")
			}
			if name == "complete" && (err != nil || forced) {
				t.Fatalf("complete cleanup: %v %v", forced, err)
			}
			if name != "complete" && err == nil {
				t.Fatal("cleanup failure was hidden")
			}
			if name == "forced" && (!forced || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "forced termination")) {
				t.Fatalf("forced cleanup reported graceful: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "job-error" && (!errors.Is(err, finishError) || !errors.Is(err, errOwnedCleanup)) {
				t.Fatalf("job cleanup cause lost: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "reader-error" && !errors.Is(err, readError) {
				t.Fatalf("reader error lost: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "unfinished-reader" && !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatalf("reader wait restarted its budget: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "log-close-error" && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
				t.Fatalf("close error lost: %v", err)
			}
			for _, file := range guest.logs {
				if _, err := file.Write([]byte("after cleanup")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrClosed) {
					t.Fatal("evidence log remains open")
				}
			}
			repeated := guest.closeLogs()
			if name == "log-close-error" && !errors.Is(repeated, os.ErrClosed) {
				t.Fatal("close failure was not sticky")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestControlCleanupRetainsConnectionCloseError(t *testing.T) {
	conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
	failure := errors.New("connection close failed")
	conn.closeError = failure
	listener := newTestControlListener(t)
	listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{conn: conn}
	control := newControlSocket(listener)
	ctx := socketTestContext(t)
	select {
	case <-control.done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal("accept did not finish")
	}
	for range 2 {
		_, err := finishGuest(nil, control, nil, time.Now().Add(time.Second))
		if !errors.Is(err, failure) {
			t.Fatalf("lost connection close failure: %v", err)
		}
	}
	if conn.closes.Load() != 1 || listener.closes.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("cleanup repeated a resource close")
	}
}

func TestSocketLifecycleFailureStagesCleanOwnedResources(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("controlled lifecycle failure")
	for _, name := range []string{"bind", "log-setup", "start", "boot-canceled", "peer-proof"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			artifacts, evidence, work := privateTestDirectory(t), privateTestDirectory(t), privateTestDirectory(t)
			pristine := filepath.Join(artifacts, "pristine.ext4")
			if err := os.WriteFile(pristine, []byte("pristine fixture bytes"), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			hash, size, err := fileHash(pristine)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			m := manifest{Artifacts: map[string]artifact{"data": {Path: "pristine.ext4", SHA256: hash, Size: size}}, BootToken: strings.Repeat("a", 64), Volume: "fixture-current"}
			m.QEMU.Machine = "pc-q35-11.1"
			log := &events{identity: testIdentity(), output: &cappedWriter{writer: io.Discard, remaining: streamLimit}}
			listener := newTestControlListener(t)
			listener.address = &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 1}
			conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
			conn.local = listener.Addr()
			if name == "peer-proof" {
				listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{conn: conn}
			}
			if name == "log-setup" {
				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(evidence, "guest-serial.log"), []byte("existing"), 0600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			process := childWithOutput("QEMU diagnostic only\n", false)
			process.verify = func(context.Context, net.Conn) (map[string]any, error) { return nil, failure }
			starts := 0
			host := fakePlatform{
				listen: func(boot context.Context) (net.Listener, error) {
					if _, ok := boot.Deadline(); !ok {
						t.Fatal("listener setup has no boot deadline")
					}
					if name == "bind" {
						return nil, failure
					}
					if name == "boot-canceled" {
						cancel()
					}
					return listener, nil
				},
				start: func(_ string, args []string, _ string) (child, error) {
					if !strings.Contains(strings.Join(args, " "), "-chardev") {
						return childWithOutput("QEMU emulator version 11.1.0 pc-q35-11.1 virtio-blk-pci virtio-net-pci virtio-rng-pci rng-builtin user tcg", true), nil
					}
					starts++
					if name == "start" {
						return nil, failure
					}
					return process, nil
				},
			}
			err = lifecycle(ctx, host, m, testIdentity(), "qemu", "bios", artifacts, evidence, work, log, false)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("failed lifecycle reported success")
			}
			switch name {
			case "bind", "start", "peer-proof":
				if !errors.Is(err, failure) {
					t.Fatalf("stage error lost: %v", err)
				}
			case "log-setup":
				if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
					t.Fatalf("log setup error lost: %v", err)
				}
			case "boot-canceled":
				if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
					t.Fatalf("boot budget lost: %v", err)
				}
			}
			wantStarts := 0
			if name == "start" || name == "peer-proof" {
				wantStarts = 1
			}
			if starts != wantStarts {
				t.Fatalf("QEMU launch count=%d want=%d", starts, wantStarts)
			}
			if name != "bind" && listener.closes.Load() != 1 {
				t.Fatal("lifecycle listener was not closed once")
			}
			if name == "peer-proof" {
				if process.finishes != 1 || process.verifications != 1 || conn.closes.Load() != 1 {
					t.Fatal("owned process or connection escaped rejected proof cleanup")
				}
				if conn.reads.Load() != 0 || conn.writes.Load() != 0 {
					t.Fatal("rejected lifecycle exchanged control bytes")
				}
			}
			actual, _, hashErr := fileHash(pristine)
			if hashErr != nil || actual != hash {
				t.Fatalf("pristine fixture changed: %v", hashErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

type terminalBytesReader struct {
	data []byte
	err  error
}

func (r *terminalBytesReader) Read(data []byte) (int, error) {
	n := copy(data, r.data)
	r.data = r.data[n:]
	if len(r.data) == 0 {
		return n, r.err
	}
	return n, nil
}

type terminalReadConn struct {
	net.Conn
	reader io.Reader
}

func (c terminalReadConn) Read(data []byte) (int, error) { return c.reader.Read(data) }

func terminalResetError() error {
	return &net.OpError{Op: "read", Net: "tcp", Err: os.NewSyscallError("wsarecv", syscall.Errno(10054))}
}

func terminalGuest(t *testing.T, data []byte, readErr error) (*guestChannel, *fakeChild) {
	t.Helper()
	guest, err := newGuestChannel(testIdentity(), privateTestDirectory(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
	process := childWithOutput("", false)
	guest.startDiagnostics(process)
	guest.startSerial(terminalReadConn{Conn: conn, reader: &terminalBytesReader{data: bytes.Clone(data), err: readErr}})
	ctx := socketTestContext(t)
	select {
	case <-guest.serial.done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal("terminal reader did not finish")
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		conn.Close()
		if err := joinReaders(socketTestContext(t), guest.readers); errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			t.Errorf("terminal reader remained unjoined: %v", err)
		}
		if err := guest.closeLogs(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("terminal evidence close: %v", err)
		}
	})
	return guest, process
}

func TestTerminalQueuedShutdownAckPrecedesResetFault(t *testing.T) {
	zero := 0
	ack := controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: "shutdown", Sequence: 4, Op: "shutdown", Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero})
	guest, process := terminalGuest(t, ack, terminalResetError())
	if len(guest.responses) != 1 || len(guest.fault) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("test did not queue exact ACK before terminal fault selection")
	}
	value, err := guest.receive(socketTestContext(t), 4, "shutdown", "shutdown")
	if err != nil || value.Sequence != 4 || value.ExitCode == nil || *value.ExitCode != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("queued final ACK was lost to reset: value=%v err=%v", value, err)
	}
	if !errors.Is(guest.serial.err, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
		t.Fatalf("raw reset observation lost: %v", guest.serial.err)
	}
	select {
	case <-process.done:
		t.Fatal("receiving ACK invented natural process exit")
	default:
	}
	if process.finishes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("terminal reset forced cleanup before natural exit")
	}
}

func TestTerminalResetRequiresExactShutdownAcknowledgement(t *testing.T) {
	zero, nonzero := 0, 1
	for _, name := range []string{"missing", "wrong-sequence", "wrong-phase", "wrong-op", "missing-exit", "nonzero-exit", "wrong-identity", "guest-error", "earlier-phase", "wrong-request-sequence"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ack := response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: "shutdown", Sequence: 4, Op: "shutdown", Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero}
			sequence, op, phase := uint64(4), "shutdown", "shutdown"
			switch name {
			case "wrong-sequence":
				ack.Sequence = 3
			case "wrong-phase":
				ack.Phase = "boot"
			case "wrong-op":
				ack.Op = "stop-authority"
			case "missing-exit":
				ack.ExitCode = nil
			case "nonzero-exit":
				ack.ExitCode = &nonzero
			case "wrong-identity":
				ack.Nonce = strings.Repeat("c", 64)
			case "guest-error":
				ack.Status = "error"
				ack.Category = "unmount"
				ack.Cause = "unmount failed"
			case "earlier-phase":
				ack.Phase = "start"
				ack.Op = "start"
				ack.Sequence = 1
				sequence, op, phase = 1, "start", "start"
			case "wrong-request-sequence":
				sequence = 5
			}
			data := controlResponseLine(t, ack)
			if name == "missing" {
				data = []byte("kernel: Power down\n")
			}
			guest, process := terminalGuest(t, data, terminalResetError())
			if _, err := guest.receive(socketTestContext(t), sequence, op, phase); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("reset supplied missing or invalid shutdown acknowledgement")
			}
			if process.finishes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("ACK failure itself invoked process cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func terminalShutdownLine(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	zero := 0
	return controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: "shutdown", Sequence: 4, Op: "shutdown", Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero})
}

func TestTerminalShutdownWaitsForNaturalExit(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"reset", "eof"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			readErr := terminalResetError()
			if name == "eof" {
				readErr = io.EOF
			}
			guest, process := terminalGuest(t, append(terminalShutdownLine(t), []byte("kernel: Power down\n")...), readErr)
			originalTerminal := guest.serial.err
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			if _, err := guest.receive(ctx, 4, "shutdown", "shutdown"); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			entered := make(chan struct{})
			var once sync.Once
			process.doneCalled = func() { once.Do(func() { close(entered) }) }
			type completion struct {
				evidence map[string]any
				err      error
			}
			finished := make(chan completion, 1)
			go func() { evidence, err := guest.awaitShutdown(ctx); finished <- completion{evidence, err} }()
			var exitOnce sync.Once
			exit := func() { exitOnce.Do(func() { close(process.done) }) }
			defer exit()
			select {
			case <-entered:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("terminal completion did not wait on owned process")
			}
			select {
			case result := <-finished:
				t.Fatalf("terminal result preceded natural process exit: %v", result.err)
			default:
			}
			if process.finishes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("serial termination forced process cleanup")
			}
			exit()
			var result completion
			select {
			case result = <-finished:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("natural exit did not complete shutdown")
			}
			if result.err != nil {
				t.Fatal(result.err)
			}
			termination, raw := "qualified-reset", readErr.Error()
			if name == "eof" {
				termination, raw = "eof", ""
			}
			if result.evidence["serial_termination"] != termination || result.evidence["serial_error"] != raw || result.evidence["serial_complete_record"] != true || result.evidence["qemu_exit"] != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("terminal evidence lost reset/EOF distinction: %v", result.evidence)
			}
			if name == "reset" && !errors.Is(guest.serial.err, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
				t.Fatalf("qualified reset was erased: %v", guest.serial.err)
			}
			deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
			if forced, err := finishGuest(process, nil, guest, deadline); forced || err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("qualified terminal result failed cleanup: forced=%v err=%v", forced, err)
			}
			if guest.serial.err != originalTerminal {
				t.Fatal("qualification or cleanup rewrote the serial result")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTerminalResetPartialTailRemainsFatal(t *testing.T) {
	reset := terminalResetError()
	guest, process := terminalGuest(t, append(terminalShutdownLine(t), []byte("unfinished kernel record")...), reset)
	var terminal *serialReadTermination
	if !errors.As(guest.serial.err, &terminal) || terminal.completeRecord || !errors.Is(guest.serial.err, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
		t.Fatalf("Scanner reset hid incomplete record: %v", guest.serial.err)
	}
	ctx := socketTestContext(t)
	_, ackErr := guest.receive(ctx, 4, "shutdown", "shutdown")
	close(process.done)
	if ackErr == nil {
		if evidence, err := guest.awaitShutdown(ctx); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("partial trailing record qualified: %v", evidence)
		}
	}
	deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
	if _, err := finishGuest(process, nil, guest, deadline); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("partial-tail serial error disappeared during cleanup")
	}
}

func TestTerminalShutdownRejectsMissingFactsAndOtherErrors(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("unrelated reader failure")
	for _, name := range []string{"no-verified-ack", "nonzero-process", "expired-deadline", "other-io", "joined-read-error", "joined-fault-error", "diagnostic-error"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			readErr := terminalResetError()
			if name == "other-io" {
				readErr = io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
			}
			if name == "joined-read-error" {
				readErr = errors.Join(readErr, failure)
			}
			guest, process := terminalGuest(t, terminalShutdownLine(t), readErr)
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			var ackErr error
			if name != "no-verified-ack" {
				_, ackErr = guest.receive(ctx, 4, "shutdown", "shutdown")
			}
			if ackErr != nil {
				if name != "other-io" && name != "joined-read-error" {
					t.Fatal(ackErr)
				}
				if name == "joined-read-error" && !errors.Is(ackErr, failure) {
					t.Fatalf("joined unrelated read error was lost: %v", ackErr)
				}
				if name == "other-io" && !errors.Is(ackErr, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
					t.Fatalf("different IO cause was lost: %v", ackErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if name == "joined-fault-error" {
				select {
				case observed := <-guest.fault:
					if !errors.Is(observed, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
						t.Fatalf("unexpected pending fault: %v", observed)
					}
				default:
				}
				guest.fault <- errors.Join(guest.serial.err, failure)
			}
			if name == "diagnostic-error" {
				done := make(chan struct{})
				close(done)
				guest.readers = append(guest.readers, &ownedReader{name: "failed diagnostic", done: done, err: failure})
			}
			if name == "nonzero-process" {
				process.result = failure
			}
			if name == "expired-deadline" {
				var cancel context.CancelFunc
				ctx, cancel = context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
				defer cancel()
			}
			close(process.done)
			if evidence, err := guest.awaitShutdown(ctx); err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("missing shutdown fact was accepted: %v", evidence)
			} else {
				if name == "expired-deadline" && !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
					t.Fatalf("shutdown restarted its deadline: %v", err)
				}
				if (name == "nonzero-process" || name == "diagnostic-error" || name == "joined-read-error" || name == "joined-fault-error") && !errors.Is(err, failure) {
					t.Fatalf("unrelated failure was swallowed: %v", err)
				}
			}
			if process.finishes != 0 {
				t.Fatal("terminal observation forced process cleanup")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTerminalQualifiedResetDoesNotForgiveJobCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	failure := errors.New("job state unknown")
	for _, name := range []string{"forced", "unknown"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			guest, process := terminalGuest(t, terminalShutdownLine(t), terminalResetError())
			ctx := socketTestContext(t)
			if _, err := guest.receive(ctx, 4, "shutdown", "shutdown"); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			close(process.done)
			if _, err := guest.awaitShutdown(ctx); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			process.forced = name == "forced"
			if name == "unknown" {
				process.finishErr = failure
			}
			deadline, _ := ctx.Deadline()
			forced, err := finishGuest(process, nil, guest, deadline)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("qualified reset hid unconfirmed job cleanup")
			}
			if name == "forced" && (!forced || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "forced termination")) {
				t.Fatalf("forced cleanup became graceful: %v", err)
			}
			if name == "unknown" && (!errors.Is(err, failure) || !errors.Is(err, errOwnedCleanup)) {
				t.Fatalf("unknown job state lost: %v", err)
			}
			againForced, again := finishGuest(process, nil, guest, deadline)
			if again == nil || againForced != forced || name == "unknown" && !errors.Is(again, failure) {
				t.Fatalf("cleanup failure was not sticky: %v", again)
			}
			if !errors.Is(guest.serial.err, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
				t.Fatal("cleanup erased raw reset evidence")
			}
		})
	}
}

type gatedTerminalReader struct {
	data    []byte
	release <-chan struct{}
	err     error
}

func (r *gatedTerminalReader) Read(data []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(r.data) > 0 {
		n := copy(data, r.data)
		r.data = r.data[n:]
		return n, nil
	}
	<-r.release
	return 0, r.err
}

func TestTerminalResetAfterAcknowledgementRecordsReset(t *testing.T) {
	guest, err := newGuestChannel(testIdentity(), privateTestDirectory(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conn, _ := controlTestPair(t)
	process := childWithOutput("", false)
	reset := terminalResetError()
	release := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	unblock := func() { once.Do(func() { close(release) }) }
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		unblock()
		conn.Close()
		if err := joinReaders(socketTestContext(t), guest.readers); errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			t.Errorf("gated terminal reader remained active: %v", err)
		}
		if err := guest.closeLogs(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("terminal log close: %v", err)
		}
	})
	guest.startDiagnostics(process)
	guest.startSerial(terminalReadConn{Conn: conn, reader: &gatedTerminalReader{data: terminalShutdownLine(t), release: release, err: reset}})
	ctx := socketTestContext(t)
	if _, err := guest.receive(ctx, 4, "shutdown", "shutdown"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-guest.serial.done:
		t.Fatal("reset arrived before the acknowledged test boundary")
	default:
	}
	unblock()
	select {
	case <-guest.serial.done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal("released reset did not arrive")
	}
	close(process.done)
	evidence, err := guest.awaitShutdown(ctx)
	if err != nil || evidence["serial_termination"] != "qualified-reset" || evidence["serial_error"] != reset.Error() || evidence["serial_complete_record"] != true {
		t.Fatalf("post-ACK reset was not preserved distinctly: %v %v", evidence, err)
	}
	if !errors.Is(guest.serial.err, syscall.Errno(10054)) {
		t.Fatal("post-ACK reset became ordinary EOF")
	}
}

func probeTestReceipt(t *testing.T, phase string, sequence uint64, epoch, object string) string {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: phase, Sequence: sequence, Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: epoch, ObjectID: object})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(data) + "\n"
}

func probeTestArguments(args []string) (map[string]string, error) {
	if len(args) != 16 {
		return nil, errors.New("probe argument count changed")
	}
	values := make(map[string]string, 8)
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i += 2 {
		if _, exists := values[args[i]]; exists {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate probe argument")
		}
		values[args[i]] = args[i+1]
	}
	id := testIdentity()
	if values["--run-id"] != id.RunID || values["--source-sha"] != id.SourceSHA || values["--fixture-nonce"] != id.Nonce || values["--volume"] != "fixture-current" || filepath.Base(values["--state-file"]) != "probe-state.json" {
		return nil, errors.New("probe arguments lost run or fixture identity")
	}
	return values, nil
}

func TestCurrentSMBColdRecoveryPreservesFirstFailure(t *testing.T) {
	first, cleanupFailure := errors.New("first cold failure"), errors.New("cleanup failure")
	for _, name := range []string{"success", "cold-error", "cold-forced", "cold-cleanup-unknown", "cold-start-unknown", "outer-canceled-guest-dead", "wrong-object", "wrong-authority", "recovery-error", "recovery-wrong-phase", "recovery-wrong-sequence", "recovery-wrong-object"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			id := testIdentity()
			seed := response{identity: id, Phase: "readiness-create", Sequence: 1, Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: "seed-authority", ObjectID: "41"}
			coldOutput := probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBColdPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, seed.ObjectID)
			if name == "wrong-object" {
				coldOutput = probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBColdPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, "42")
			}
			if name == "wrong-authority" {
				coldOutput = probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBColdPhase, 2, "other-authority", seed.ObjectID)
			}
			cleanupOutput := probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBCleanupPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, seed.ObjectID)
			if name == "recovery-wrong-phase" {
				cleanupOutput = probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBColdPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, seed.ObjectID)
			}
			if name == "recovery-wrong-sequence" {
				cleanupOutput = probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBCleanupPhase, 3, seed.AuthorityEpoch, seed.ObjectID)
			}
			if name == "recovery-wrong-object" {
				cleanupOutput = probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBCleanupPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, "42")
			}
			guest := &guestChannel{identity: id, child: childWithOutput("", false), fault: make(chan error, 1)}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			coldChild := childWithOutput(coldOutput, true)
			if name != "success" && name != "wrong-object" && name != "wrong-authority" {
				coldChild.result = first
			}
			quiescent := false
			coldChild.finishBefore = func(time.Time) (bool, error) {
				if name == "cold-cleanup-unknown" {
					return false, cleanupFailure
				}
				quiescent = true
				if name == "outer-canceled-guest-dead" {
					cancel()
					close(guest.child.(*fakeChild).done)
				}
				return name == "cold-forced" || name == "outer-canceled-guest-dead", nil
			}
			var calls []string
			host := fakePlatform{start: func(_ string, args []string, _ string) (child, error) {
				values, err := probeTestArguments(args)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				if values["--sequence"] != "2" {
					return nil, errors.New("cold/recovery sequence changed")
				}
				phase := values["--phase"]
				calls = append(calls, phase)
				switch phase {
				case currentSMBColdPhase:
					if name == "cold-start-unknown" {
						return nil, first
					}
					return coldChild, nil
				case currentSMBCleanupPhase:
					if !quiescent {
						return nil, errors.New("mapping recovery overlapped the cold child")
					}
					if name == "outer-canceled-guest-dead" && ctx.Err() == nil {
						return nil, errors.New("test did not cancel the outer context")
					}
					p := childWithOutput(cleanupOutput, true)
					if name == "recovery-error" {
						p.result = cleanupFailure
					}
					return p, nil
				default:
					return nil, errors.New("unexpected recovery helper phase")
				}
			}}
			var recorded bytes.Buffer
			log := &events{identity: id, output: &cappedWriter{writer: &recorded, remaining: streamLimit}}
			err := runCurrentSMBCold(ctx, host, guest, seed, "probe", privateTestDirectory(t), "http://127.0.0.1:12345", "fixture-current", log)
			if name == "success" {
				if err != nil || len(calls) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("healthy cold probe: calls=%v error=%v", calls, err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("recovery promoted a failed cold probe to success")
			}
			if name != "wrong-object" && name != "wrong-authority" && !errors.Is(err, first) {
				t.Fatalf("first failure lost: %v", err)
			}
			blocked := name == "cold-cleanup-unknown" || name == "cold-start-unknown"
			if blocked {
				if len(calls) != 1 || !errors.Is(err, errOwnedCleanup) || !strings.Contains(recorded.String(), `"status":"blocked"`) {
					t.Fatalf("unconfirmed child permitted recovery: calls=%v err=%v", calls, err)
				}
			} else if len(calls) != 2 || calls[1] != currentSMBCleanupPhase {
				t.Fatalf("recovery was missing or repeated: %v", calls)
			}
			if name == "recovery-error" && !errors.Is(err, cleanupFailure) {
				t.Fatalf("cleanup failure lost: %v", err)
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "recovery-") && !strings.Contains(recorded.String(), `"status":"error"`) {
				t.Fatalf("failed recovery was reported successful: %s", recorded.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCurrentSMBRecoveryUsesOneAbsoluteBudget(t *testing.T) {
	seed := response{identity: testIdentity(), AuthorityEpoch: "seed-authority", ObjectID: "41"}
	for _, name := range []string{"complete", "no-deadline", "insufficient-command-budget"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			var deadline time.Time
			if name != "no-deadline" {
				budget := 30 * time.Second
				if name == "insufficient-command-budget" {
					budget = 5 * time.Second
				}
				var cancel context.CancelFunc
				ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, budget)
				defer cancel()
				deadline, _ = ctx.Deadline()
			}
			p := childWithOutput(probeTestReceipt(t, currentSMBCleanupPhase, 2, seed.AuthorityEpoch, seed.ObjectID), true)
			starts := 0
			host := fakePlatform{start: func(string, []string, string) (child, error) { starts++; return p, nil }}
			_, err := recoverSMBMapping(ctx, host, testIdentity(), seed, "probe", privateTestDirectory(t), "http://127.0.0.1:12345", "fixture-current")
			if name == "complete" {
				if err != nil || starts != 1 || p.finishes != 1 || p.finishDeadline.After(deadline) {
					t.Fatalf("recovery escaped its cleanup bound: start=%d finish=%d err=%v", starts, p.finishes, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil || starts != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unbounded or exhausted recovery launched a child: starts=%d err=%v", starts, err)
			}
			if name == "insufficient-command-budget" && !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatalf("Job-cleanup reserve was lost: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestToolCleanupClampsTheSuppliedDeadline(t *testing.T) {
	p := childWithOutput("complete", true)
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	if _, err := runToolBefore(socketTestContext(t), fakePlatform{process: p}, "tool", nil, privateTestDirectory(t), "bounded", deadline); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !p.finishDeadline.Equal(deadline) {
		t.Fatalf("cleanup deadline changed: got=%s want=%s", p.finishDeadline, deadline)
	}
}

func TestCurrentSMBPhaseOrderUsesSingleGuest(t *testing.T) {
	for _, enabled := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "http-only"
		if enabled {
			name = "current-smb-cold"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			artifacts, evidence, work := privateTestDirectory(t), privateTestDirectory(t), privateTestDirectory(t)
			pristine := filepath.Join(artifacts, "pristine.ext4")
			if err := os.WriteFile(pristine, []byte("fixture bytes"), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			hash, size, err := fileHash(pristine)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			m := manifest{Artifacts: map[string]artifact{"data": {Path: "pristine.ext4", SHA256: hash, Size: size}, "probe_windows_arm64": {Path: "probe.exe"}}, Volume: "fixture-current", BootToken: strings.Repeat("a", 64)}
			m.QEMU.Machine = "pc-q35-11.1"
			listener := newTestControlListener(t)
			listener.address = &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: 1}
			conn, peer := controlTestPair(t)
			conn.local = listener.Addr()
			conn.setWriteDeadline = func(deadline time.Time) error {
				// net.Pipe rejects a deadline reset after peer EOF, unlike a live TCP handle.
				if deadline.IsZero() {
					return nil
				}
				return conn.Conn.SetWriteDeadline(deadline)
			}
			listener.result <- controlAcceptResult{conn: conn}
			qemu := childWithOutput("diagnostic output\n", false)
			var exitOnce sync.Once
			exit := func() { exitOnce.Do(func() { close(qemu.done) }) }
			var natural atomic.Bool
			qemu.finishBefore = func(time.Time) (bool, error) {
				select {
				case <-qemu.done:
					return !natural.Load(), nil
				default:
					peer.Close()
					exit()
					return true, nil
				}
			}
			var orderMu sync.Mutex
			var order []string
			record := func(event string) { orderMu.Lock(); order = append(order, event); orderMu.Unlock() }
			peerDone := make(chan error, 1)
			started, joined := false, false
			t.Cleanup(func() {
				peer.Close()
				conn.Conn.Close()
				exit()
				if started && !joined {
					select {
					case <-peerDone:
					case <-socketTestContext(t).Done():
						t.Error("scripted guest did not stop")
					}
				}
			})
			if err := peer.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			boot := controlResponseLine(t, response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: "boot", Op: "boot-ready", Status: "ok"})
			qemuStarts := 0
			host := fakePlatform{listener: listener, start: func(executable string, args []string, _ string) (child, error) {
				if strings.HasSuffix(executable, "probe.exe") {
					values, err := probeTestArguments(args)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					phase, sequence := values["--phase"], values["--sequence"]
					record("probe:" + phase + "/" + sequence)
					epoch := "seed-authority"
					if phase == "readiness-reopen" {
						epoch = "reopened-authority"
					}
					value := response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: phase, Sequence: 2, Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: epoch, ObjectID: "41"}
					if phase == "readiness-create" {
						value.Sequence = 1
					}
					data, err := json.Marshal(value)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					return childWithOutput(string(data), true), nil
				}
				if !strings.Contains(strings.Join(args, " "), "-chardev") {
					return childWithOutput("QEMU emulator version 11.1.0 pc-q35-11.1 virtio-blk-pci virtio-net-pci virtio-rng-pci rng-builtin user tcg", true), nil
				}
				qemuStarts++
				if qemuStarts != 1 {
					return nil, errors.New("cold phase launched another guest")
				}
				started = true
				go func() {
					result := func() error {
						if _, err := peer.Write(boot); err != nil {
							return err
						}
						reader := bufio.NewReader(peer)
						for index, op := range []string{"start", "stop-authority", "start", "shutdown"} {
							line, err := reader.ReadBytes('\n')
							if err != nil {
								return err
							}
							var command struct {
								Nonce    string `json:"nonce"`
								Sequence uint64 `json:"sequence"`
								Command  string `json:"command"`
							}
							if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &command); err != nil {
								return err
							}
							if command.Nonce != testIdentity().Nonce || command.Sequence != uint64(index+1) || command.Command != op {
								return errors.New("guest command sequence changed")
							}
							record("guest:" + op + "/" + strconv.Itoa(index+1))
							zero := 0
							ack, err := json.Marshal(response{identity: testIdentity(), Phase: op, Sequence: command.Sequence, Op: op, Status: "ok", ExitCode: &zero})
							if err != nil {
								return err
							}
							if _, err := peer.Write(append(append([]byte(responsePrefix), ack...), '\n')); err != nil {
								return err
							}
						}
						return nil
					}()
					if result == nil {
						natural.Store(true)
					}
					peer.Close()
					exit()
					peerDone <- result
				}()
				return qemu, nil
			}}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			log := &events{identity: testIdentity(), output: &cappedWriter{writer: io.Discard, remaining: streamLimit}}
			if err := lifecycle(ctx, host, m, testIdentity(), "qemu", "bios", artifacts, evidence, work, log, enabled); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			select {
			case err := <-peerDone:
				joined = true
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("scripted guest did not complete")
			}
			want := []string{"guest:start/1", "probe:readiness-create/1"}
			if enabled {
				want = append(want, "probe:current-smb-cold/2")
			}
			want = append(want, "guest:stop-authority/2", "guest:start/3", "probe:readiness-reopen/2", "guest:shutdown/4")
			orderMu.Lock()
			got := append([]string(nil), order...)
			orderMu.Unlock()
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) || qemuStarts != 1 || qemu.finishes != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("phase order/guest count differs: order=%v guests=%d finishes=%d", got, qemuStarts, qemu.finishes)
			}
		})
	}
}
